content: Durable execution for AI agents (Temporal-style): record full event history of steps/tool calls and their returned values; replay history to reconstruct in-memory state after crash so agent resumes at exact failed step without re-running completed work. Non-deterministic side effects (LLM outputs, timestamps, retrieval) must be recorded once and reused on replay. Enables pause for approval, cross-worker rehydration, days-long runs. Idempotent tool design required.
